AI is everywhere in your company. AI value is not.

New research from SAP and Oxford Economics measured something most dashboards miss. Organizations are already running AI across 25% of their business tasks. But only 9% have fundamentally adapted their business around it.

That means 91% of companies are layering AI onto processes designed for a pre-AI world. Faster spreadsheets. Smarter search bars. Automated versions of workflows that were never optimized in the first place.

The 9% that broke through did something different. They did not just deploy tools — they rewired how their organizations make decisions. New data governance. New performance metrics. New operating models built around what AI makes possible, not what humans used to do manually.

This gap is about to become a chasm. As AI agents, multimodal reasoning, and real-time decision systems mature, the distance between companies that bolted AI on and companies that built around AI will define market leadership.

The strategic question is not whether you have adopted AI. It is whether your operating model is designed to extract value from it.
